text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, looking solely at the result, I suppose that's true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot afford
to be satisfied here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"To serve as a model for all Umamusume,
I must continually remain at the absolute peak."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is all I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I know that without being told.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If I were satisfied with just this,
how could I ever call myself the 'Empress'?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: As soon as we get back, we'll identify the areas we need to improve and rethink the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The issues I already know of are too many
to count on both hands. Time is of the essence right now.
